about: Yle (Finnish public broadcaster) News in English: search articles and Areena programs, read articles, browse latest, front-page and topic news lists, and look up video metadata.

commands.summary: Keyword search across Yle articles and Areena programs, with filters for type, service, language and author

params.name: type
params.description: Restrict to one content type. Leave it out to search all types.

params.name: service
params.description: Restrict to one Yle service, e.g. 'uutiset' (news)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip, used for paging

commands.summary: Get an article's metadata (headline, description, publish and modify dates, keywords, author, images) from its JSON-LD

params.name: id
params.description: Article id from the yle.fi/a/<id> URL, e.g. 74-20250494

commands.summary: Get an article's body text as an ordered list of paragraphs and subheadings

params.name: id
params.description: Article id from the yle.fi/a/<id> URL, e.g. 74-20215566

commands.summary: List the latest Yle News (English) articles, newest first
List the stories currently on the Yle News (English) front page, with leads
List recent English articles for a topic (e.g. 18-220306 Politics, 18-34837 Domestic news, 18-204933 Economy)

params.name: topic_id
params.description: Topic id from the yle.fi/t/<id>/en URL, e.g. 18-220306 (Politics)

commands.summary: Get metadata for a Yle/Areena video program (title, series, duration, start time, HLS manifest URL)

params.name: id
params.description: Areena program id, e.g. 1-78744762 (from areena.yle.fi/1-<id> links in search results)
